frictions.title: Insight and advice sit in different channels
frictions.now: The surplus analysis and inflation tool exist only in the internet bank, the savings guide only in the app. The customer switches channel mid-decision and takes nothing along.
frictions.recommendation: Plan each service across the whole journey, not per channel. Either offer analysis and guide in both channels, or join them with deep links that carry the result.
frictions.othersPattern: Analysis and investment proposal in one flow.

frictions.title: Webviews only handle isolated tasks
frictions.now: The guide's proposal needs a fund account or ISK, a separate task the customer is normally linked to. A flow that links on cannot run in a webview, so services like the guide cannot be moved between channels as webviews.
frictions.recommendation: Mark which tasks are isolated and which link on. Use webviews only for isolated tasks; build natively, or require linking and return to the original flow, where the service is part of a longer journey.
frictions.othersPattern: Account opening in a few taps from inside the app's flow.

frictions.title: Information does not hang together
frictions.now: The public website describes the tools but does not lead into the right step. Names and structure differ between web and app.
frictions.recommendation: Shared terms and content model for the tools in every channel, and entry points that land on the right step after login.
frictions.othersPattern: Same names and structure for tools in every channel.

frictions.title: Fund trading is being built for two channels
frictions.now: Fund trading exists in the internet bank and is coming to the app. Without one shared capability, rules, terms and the guide's proposal risk differing.
frictions.recommendation: One shared capability with two interfaces: the same rules, the same terms, and the guide's proposal available in both.
frictions.othersPattern: One trading capability with the same experience everywhere.

frictions.title: Customer service cannot see the customer's context
frictions.now: The analysis and fund proposal are invisible to customer service. The customer explains their situation from the start.
frictions.recommendation: Context sharing: analysis results and proposals follow the customer to customer service and advisors.
frictions.othersPattern: Support and advisors see the same material as the customer.

frictions.title: Nobody measures the whole journey
frictions.now: Use is measured per channel and per tool. Drop-off between analysis, guide and fund account is invisible.
frictions.recommendation: Measure the journey against the shared goal: share of small businesses that start investing, with drop-off per transition.
frictions.othersPattern: Goals and measurement per customer journey, not per channel.
